string-array.name: rooms_guide_d
string-array.item: One room per group work. It is not a reminder: it is where you all actually build it and where the final document comes from.
You pick the subject, the type of work —essay, report, presentation— and whether you assign the parts or everyone takes one.
Inside the work there is a six-character code. Whoever has it joins with just their name: no account, nothing else to install.
The type of work already brings its sections. Each one is in charge of someone, with its own date —not just the final one.
A Word file, a photo, a source, a link. The text is pulled out of the Word file, and what you upload shows up instantly on everyone else’s phone.
Whoever created the room taps “Create work”: the document is put together with the sections in order and the bibliography in the chosen style.
It reaches everyone in the group and the room becomes read-only. Anyone who opens it later sees the finished work, not the organizer.
